title: brassica fruticulosa subsp. glaberrima
intro: Brassica fruticulosa subsp. glaberrima, commonly known as wild rocket or glabrous rocket, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. This plant is rich in nutrients and offers several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in the prevention of chronic diseases such as cancer and heart disease. The therapeutic actions of Brassica fruticulosa subsp. glaberrima include its ability to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage, as well as its potential to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
